svg.title: AI safety supervisor with a verifiable requirements graph
svg.desc: Safety supervisor consuming a verifiable requirements graph. The supervisor evaluates proposed actions against authenticated requirements and records the outcome. Supporting credentials are checked at load and update, and again per decision if the policy requires it. Local protective functions operate separately. Timing examples come from the prototype measurements and the projections in Tables 6 and 7.

rdf:Alt.rdf:li: AI safety supervisor with a verifiable requirements graph

Safety supervisor consuming a verifiable requirements graph. The supervisor evaluates proposed actions against authenticated requirements and records the outcome. Supporting credentials are checked at load and update, and again per decision if the policy requires it. Local protective functions operate separately. Timing examples come from the prototype measurements and the projections in Tables 6 and 7.
